snippet.title: Castlevania Resurrection Dreamcast E3 1999 Prototype Source Release
snippet.description:
The first information about Castlevania Resurrection on Dreamcast began appearing in magazines during the summer of 1999.

Looking at the screenshots published in our magazines, one thing quickly became clear: Resurrection had undeniable visual punch!

And yet… some media outlets were already expressing reservations. The game would eventually disappear into limbo, almost completely unnoticed. Cancelled in spring 2000, it would take 21 years before the existence of a very rare version shown at E3 1999 was finally uncovered.

The story takes place in 1666. Castlevania Resurrection was set to have players take control of Sonia Belmont, a woman born with a supernatural ability to sense the presence of spirits. She was supposed to be accompanied by a certain Victor Belmont. During the adventure, players were apparently meant to switch between the two protagonists, perhaps even across different time periods.

The E3 1999 prototype of Castlevania Resurrection contains four stages, with a fifth accessible through an emulator.

Video captured directly on a Dreamcast, without any modifications or tricks, by me.

00:00 - 02:32 = Torture
02:32 - 04.40 = Death Prayer
04:40 - 05:48 = Snake Food
